description: Codex installed through npm runs as `node` (node running the codex script), so tmux's foreground process names no agent. This working screen shows no model or session footer, only Codex's own chrome: the bullet transcript (• Explored, • Ran, └ output), 'Working (… • esc to interrupt)', 'tab to queue message' and 'N% context left'. The work itself is about Claude Code (the docs it edits name it), and the model reads it as 'claude' every time, as it did live. The process tree under the pane is the ground truth: node running codex must pin the tool, as `processes` replays here.
